outlooks.summary: SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS CAPABLE OF MAINLY DAMAGING WIND GUSTS AND HAIL WILL BE POSSIBLE THIS AFTERNOON INTO TONIGHT FROM THE LOWER MISSOURI VALLEY EAST ACROSS THE OHIO VALLEY TO THE TIDEWATER REGION. ANOTHER AREA OF SEVERE STORMS YIELDING LARGE HAIL AND SWATHS OF WIND DAMAGE WILL MATERIALIZE OVER THE NORTHERN AND CENTRAL HIGH PLAINS TODAY INTO TONIGHT.

sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: THE LARGE-SCALE FLOW PATTERN WILL AMPLIFY THROUGH THE DAY ONE PERIOD AS A RIDGE BUILDS OVER THE INTERMOUNTAIN WEST AND DOWNSTREAM HEIGHTS LOWER FROM THE GREAT LAKES INTO OZARKS. A COUPLE OF MORE PROMINENT SHORT-WAVE TROUGHS ARE PRESENT WITHIN THIS UPPER-AIR PATTERN...ONE OF WHICH WILL TRANSLATE FROM THE NRN HIGH PLAINS INTO THE MID MO VALLEY. THE OTHER WILL MOVE THROUGH THE OH VALLEY TO MID-ATLANTIC COAST. AT THE SURFACE...AN AREA OF LOW PRESSURE RELATED TO THE LATTER IMPULSE MENTIONED ABOVE WILL DEVELOP EWD THROUGH THE OH VALLEY...EVENTUALLY REACHING THE DELMARVA BY 12Z/FRIDAY. A W-E ORIENTED FRONT --LOCALLY MODULATED BY CONVECTIVE OUTFLOW-- TRAILING THIS MIGRATORY CYCLONE WILL EXTEND WWD TO A DEEPENING LEE LOW OVER ERN CO...WHILE FARTHER TO THE NORTH...A COLD FRONT WILL SHIFT SWD THROUGH THE NRN HIGH PLAINS.

sections.title: NRN/CNTRL HIGH PLAINS TODAY INTO TONIGHT
sections.text: A GRADUAL INCREASE IN TSTM COVERAGE AND INTENSITY IS ANTICIPATED THIS MORNING FROM SERN MT AND NERN WY INTO WRN SD AS LARGE-SCALE FORCING FOR ASCENT/DCVA ATTENDANT TO THE CNTRL MT SHORT-WAVE TROUGH OVERSPREADS THE REGION. THE COMBINATION OF STEEP MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES AND MODERATELY STRONG EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR WILL SUPPORT SOME STORM ORGANIZATION /POSSIBLY SUPERCELLS/ WITH A RISK FOR MAINLY SEVERE HAIL. EARLY-DAY STORMS OVER THE NRN HIGH PLAINS SHOULD FURTHER STRENGTHEN BY AFTERNOON WITH ADDITIONAL DEVELOPMENT OCCURRING WITH THE UPSLOPE FLOW REGIME FROM NEAR AND NORTH OF THE CHEYENNE RIDGE TO PALMER DIVIDE. AMPLE VERTICAL SHEAR AND MODERATE INSTABILITY /I.E. MLCAPE OF 1000-2000 J PER KG/ WILL PROMOTE SUPERCELL MORPHOLOGIES WITH A RISK FOR LARGE HAIL AND LOCALLY DAMAGING WINDS. WITH TIME...MODEL GUIDANCE IS STRONGLY SUGGESTIVE THAT STORMS WILL COALESCE INTO SEWD-MOVING CLUSTERS OR A LARGER-SCALE MCS WITH A CONCENTRATED RISK FOR DAMAGING WINDS SPREADING FROM PARTS OF WRN NEB INTO NERN CO AND NWRN KS LATE THIS AFTERNOON THROUGH EVENING. ...LOWER MO VALLEY EWD THROUGH THE OH VALLEY TO MID ATLANTIC COAST THIS AFTERNOON INTO TONIGHT... A NOCTURNAL MCS HAS BECOME ELONGATED IN W-E FASHION

outlooks.summary: SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS CAPABLE OF MAINLY DAMAGING WIND GUSTS AND HAIL MAY OCCUR THIS AFTERNOON AND EVENING FROM THE LOWER MISSOURI VALLEY EAST ACROSS THE OHIO VALLEY TO THE TIDEWATER REGION. A COUPLE OF TORNADOES CANNOT BE RULED OUT OVER A PORTION OF VIRGINIA. ANOTHER AREA OF SEVERE STORMS YIELDING LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WIND WILL MATERIALIZE OVER THE NORTHERN AND CENTRAL HIGH PLAINS TODAY INTO THIS EVENING.

sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: LARGE-SCALE PATTERN WILL AMPLIFY THIS PERIOD AS A RIDGE BUILDS OVER THE INTERMOUNTAIN WEST AND DOWNSTREAM HEIGHTS LOWER FROM THE GREAT LAKES INTO OZARKS. A COUPLE OF MORE PROMINENT SHORT-WAVE TROUGHS ARE PRESENT WITHIN THIS UPPER-AIR PATTERN...ONE OF WHICH WILL MOVE FROM THE NRN HIGH PLAINS INTO THE MID MO VALLEY. THE OTHER WILL MOVE THROUGH THE OH VALLEY TO MID-ATLANTIC COAST. AT THE SURFACE...A LEE LOW WILL DEVELOP OVER VA AND SHIFT NEWD WITH TIME...REACHING THE DELMARVA BY 12Z/FRIDAY. SURFACE ANALYSIS SHOWS A WARM FRONT FROM NERN NC NWWD INTO ERN KY WHERE IT INTERSECTS AN OUTFLOW BOUNDARY THAT STRETCHES FROM ERN OH THROUGH NRN KY AND SRN IND...CNTRL IL THEN NWWD INTO SRN IA WHERE IT INTERSECTS A QUASI-STATIONARY FRONT THAT EXTENDS SWWD THROUGH NRN AND WRN KS. FARTHER TO THE NORTH...A COLD FRONT WILL SHIFT SWD THROUGH THE NRN HIGH PLAINS.

sections.title: NRN/CNTRL HIGH PLAINS
sections.text: STORMS CONTINUE OVER THE CNTRL/NRN HIGH PLAINS FROM ERN WY INTO WRN SD IN ASSOCIATION WITH FORCING FOR ASCENT ACCOMPANYING A SHORTWAVE TROUGH MOVING ESEWD THROUGH NERN WY AND ERN MT. GRADUAL INCREASE IN INTENSITY IS EXPECTED AS THIS ACTIVITY CONTINUES SEWD INTO THE DESTABILIZING BOUNDARY LAYER WHERE ELY NEAR SFC WINDS WILL MAINTAIN NEAR-SFC DEWPOINTS NEAR 60F. OBJECTIVE ANALYSIS AND THE 12Z RAOB FROM NORTH PLATTE SHOWS A CAPPING INVERSION IN PLACE WITH SEWD EXTENT INTO THE CNTRL HIGH PLAINS WHERE THE EML HAS OVERSPREAD THE WARM SECTOR. THIS SUGGESTS INITIAL STORMS MIGHT WEAKEN...BUT ADDITIONAL STORMS WILL LIKELY DEVELOP FARTHER WEST OVER THE HIGHER TERRAIN AND SPREAD SEWD DURING THE AFTERNOON. MLCAPE FROM 1500-2000 J/KG AND 30-40 KT EFFECTIVE SHEAR WILL SUPPORT SUPERCELL STRUCTURES AND BOWING SEGMENTS WITH LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WIND THE MAIN THREATS.

sections.title: MID-ATLANTIC AREA
sections.text: THE ATMOSPHERE WILL CONTINUE TO DESTABILIZE IN THIS REGION AS WARM FRONT LIFTS NWD AND UPPER 60S/LOW 70S DEWPOINTS ADVECT THROUGH WARM SECTOR. LATEST VISIBLE IMAGERY SHOWS SUBSTANTIAL WARMING OF THE BOUNDARY LAYER IS OCCURRING AND MLCAPE SHOULD REACH 2000 J/KG THIS AFTERNOON. A BELT OF STRONGER MID-LEVEL FLOW ALONG THE SRN PERIPHERY OF THE OHIO VALLEY SHORTWAVE THROUGH WILL MOVE OVER THIS REGION WITH STRONGER SHEAR /35-45 KT/ EXPECTED OVER VA AND SOMEWHAT WEAKER FARTHER SOUTH INTO NC. AS THE ATMOSPHERE CONTINUES TO DESTABILIZE...POTENTIAL EXISTS FOR STORMS TO DEVELOP IN WARM SECTOR...THE HIGHER TERRAIN AS WELL AS ALONG RESIDUAL CONVECTIVE OUTFLOW THAT WILL MOVE INTO WRN VA THIS AFTERNOON. DAMAGING WIND AND LARGE HAIL WILL BE THE MAIN THREATS BUT A COUPLE TORNADOES CANNOT BE RULED OUT...ESPECIALLY OVER A PORTION OF VA.

sections.title: SRN HALF OF OH VALLEY
sections.text: THE MOIST AND UNSTABLE WARM SECTOR CONTINUES ADVECT EWD THROUGH SRN PORTIONS OF THE OH VALLEY AND TO THE SOUTH OF A CONVECTIVE OUTFLOW BOUNDARY. LATEST OBJECTIVE ANALYSIS SHOWS A CORRIDOR OF 1500-2500 J/KG MLCAPE FROM SERN MO THROUGH SRN IL AND WRN KY. THIS REGION RESIDES ALONG SRN FRINGE OF STRONGER WINDS ALOFT WITH GENERALLY 30-40 KT UNIDIRECTIONAL DEEP SHEAR. POTENTIAL EXISTS FOR STORMS TO REDEVELOP ALONG RESIDUAL OUTFLOW BOUNDARY AND SPREAD SEWD. BOTH MULTICELL AND SUPERCELL STRUCTURES WILL BE POSSIBLE WITH DAMAGING WIND AND LARGE HAIL THE MAIN THREATS.

sections.title: NRN KS THROUGH NRN MO
sections.text: OTHER STORMS ARE EXPECTED TO DEVELOP ALONG AND JUST NORTH OF E-W BOUNDARY WHERE STEEP LAPSE RATES WILL EXIST AND THE ATMOSPHERE WILL BECOME MODERATELY TO STRONGLY UNSTABLE. GENERALLY WEAK SHEAR WILL SUPPORT MULTICELL STORM MODES WITH ISOLATED DAMAGING WIND AND LARGE HAIL THE MAIN THREATS. ..DIAL/COOK.. 06/25/2015

outlooks.summary: SCATTERED SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS WILL REMAIN POSSIBLE ACROSS PORTIONS OF THE TIDEWATER REGION AND VICINITY...AND ACROSS PARTS OF THE CENTRAL HIGH PLAINS...FOR THE REMAINDER OF THIS AFTERNOON INTO TONIGHT. MORE ISOLATED SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS WILL BE POSSIBLE ELSEWHERE ACROSS THE MID-ATLANTIC REGION TO PORTIONS OF EASTERN WYOMING AND EASTERN COLORADO.

sections.title: THERE IS A MRGL RISK OF SVR TSTMS ACROSS PORTIONS OF SERN AZ
sections.text: ...SUMMARY... SCATTERED SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS WILL REMAIN POSSIBLE ACROSS PORTIONS OF THE TIDEWATER REGION AND VICINITY...AND ACROSS PARTS OF THE CENTRAL HIGH PLAINS...FOR THE REMAINDER OF THIS AFTERNOON INTO TONIGHT. MORE ISOLATED SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS WILL BE POSSIBLE ELSEWHERE ACROSS THE MID-ATLANTIC REGION TO PORTIONS OF EASTERN WYOMING AND EASTERN COLORADO.

sections.title: PRIMARY CHANGES TO THE DAY-1 CONVECTIVE OUTLOOK
sections.text: /1/ PORTIONS OF THE TIDEWATER REGION OF VA AND VICINITY /INCLUDING PARTS OF FAR NRN NC/ HAVE BEEN UPGRADED TO THE ENH CATEGORY FOR AN ENHANCED RISK OF SEVERE WIND GUSTS THIS EVENING. A CONVECTIVELY AUGMENTED MESOSCALE CIRCULATION IS CROSSING PARTS OF THE UPPER OH VALLEY INTO THE CNTRL APPALACHIANS PER RECENT MOSAIC RADAR LOOPS/SATELLITE IMAGERY. THIS FEATURE IS PRECEDED BY A CONSISTENT/MIGRATORY AREA OF 2-HOURLY PRESSURE FALLS OF 2-4 MB -- A MANIFESTATION OF UPWARD MOTION RELATED TO THE MCV. MEANWHILE...THE AIR MASS CONTINUES TO DESTABILIZE S OF A WARM FRONT THAT INTERSECTS A N/S-ORIENTED LEE TROUGH IN CNTRL VA...WITH THE FRONT EXTENDING SEWD TO THE LOWER CHESAPEAKE BAY. AS FORCING FOR ASCENT ATTENDANT TO THE MCV INTERACTS WITH MLCAPE AROUND 1000-2000 J/KG NEAR/S OF THE FRONT WHERE MLCINH IS WEAK...TSTMS WILL LIKELY INCREASE IN COVERAGE AND INTENSITY -- ESPECIALLY EARLY IN THE EVENING. THE PRESENCE OF 40-50 KT OF EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR WILL SUPPORT INITIAL SUPERCELL STRUCTURES EVOLVING INTO ONE OR MORE BOWING LINEAR SEGMENTS. THE COMBINATION OF THE LATEST OBSERVATIONAL TRENDS HIGHLIGHTING THE APPROACHING MCV OVERTAKING THE RETURNING MOISTURE ACROSS THE PIEDMONT/COASTAL PLAIN...COUPLE

mesoscale_discussions.summary: ISOLATED STRONG AND DAMAGING WIND GUSTS AND GENERALLY SUB-SEVERE HAIL WILL BE POSSIBLE AS TWO LINES OF STORMS MOVE TO THE SOUTHEAST ACROSS SOUTHERN INDIANA AND EXTREME SOUTHWEST OHIO INTO PARTS OF NORTHERN AND CENTRAL KENTUCKY THIS MORNING. GIVEN THE EXPECTED ISOLATED NATURE OF A SEVERE WIND THREAT AND SHORT DURATION /THROUGH ABOUT 15Z/...A WATCH IS NOT ANTICIPATED AT THIS TIME.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: AT 1210Z...MOSAIC RADAR IMAGERY SHOWED STORMS MOVING TO THE SOUTHEAST THROUGH SOUTHERN INDIANA...WITH ONE LINE EXTENDING FROM KNOX COUNTY TO MORGAN AND JOHNSON COUNTIES...WHILE A SECOND SHORTER LINE EXTENDED FROM JENNINGS COUNTY TO RIPLEY AND FRANKLIN COUNTIES. IR SATELLITE IMAGERY INDICATED CLOUD TOP COOLING WITH THIS ACTIVITY...WHILE GOES-R OVERSHOOTING TOP PRODUCT INDICATED A FEW EMBEDDED STRONGER UPDRAFTS WITH THESE STORMS OVER THE SOUTHERN HALF OF INDIANA. A 35-45 KT WLY LLJ EXTENDING FROM THE LOWER MO VALLEY INTO THE WRN/SWRN PORTION OF THE SRN INDIANA TSTM COMPLEX WILL MAINTAIN AN INFLUX OF AT LEAST MODERATE INSTABILITY UNTIL ABOUT 15Z AND SUSTAIN SOME STRONGER CORES INTO FAR SOUTHERN IND AND ADJACENT NORTHERN KY. THEREAFTER...THE LLJ IS EXPECTED TO WEAKEN THROUGH 18Z...SUGGESTING THESE TSTMS SHOULD DIMINISH IN INTENSITY. GIVEN THE EXPECTED ISOLATED COVERAGE OF STRONG TO SEVERE STORMS AND SOMEWHAT SHORT DURATION OF A SEVERE THREAT...A SEVERE THUNDERSTORM WATCH IS NOT ANTICIPATED ACROSS THIS DISCUSSION AREA THIS MORNING.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THUNDERSTORMS ARE EXPECTED TO INCREASE IN COVERAGE AND INTENSITY THIS MORNING WITH THE PRIMARY HAZARD BEING LARGE HAIL. THIS THREAT SHOULD REMAIN FAIRLY ISOLATED INITIALLY...THOUGH THE SEVERE STORMS MAY BECOME MORE NUMEROUS LATER THIS MORNING...POTENTIALLY NECESSITATING A WATCH.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A GENERAL INCREASE IN TSTM ACTIVITY HAS BEEN OBSERVED DURING THE PAST HOUR OVER CNTRL MT /E OF LWT/ WITH OTHER STORMS PERSISTING SW OF GCC IN NERN WY. THE FORMER STORMS SIGNAL THE LEADING EDGE OF STRONGER HEIGHT FALLS/DCVA ASSOCIATED WITH A SHORT-WAVE TROUGH TRANSLATING THROUGH CNTRL MT. DOWNSTREAM 12Z SOUNDINGS AT RIW AND RAP SAMPLED A RELATIVELY MOIST LOW-LEVEL AIR MASS SURMOUNTED BY 700-500-MB LAPSE RATES OF 7.5-8.5 C/KM...YIELDING MUCAPE OF 1000-1500 J/KG. LATEST MODEL GUIDANCE REMAINS CONSISTENT IN SUGGESTING THAT STORMS SHOULD INCREASE IN COVERAGE AND INTENSITY OVER THE DISCUSSION AREA THIS MORNING AS THE FORCING FOR ASCENT ASSOCIATED WITH THE SHORT-WAVE TROUGH OVERSPREADS A PROGRESSIVELY MORE UNSTABLE AIR MASS. EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR OF 40+ KT WILL SUPPORT ORGANIZED STORM MODES INCLUDING SUPERCELLS WITH THE PRIMARY HAZARD BEING LARGE HAIL. WHILE A WATCH IS NOT ANTICIPATED IN THE NEXT COUPLE OF HOURS...ONE COULD BE REQUIRED LATER THIS MORNING. ..MEAD.. 06/25/2015 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A FEW STORMS CAPABLE OF LARGE HAIL AND EVENTUALLY DAMAGING WINDS ARE EXPECTED TO EVOLVE ACROSS MAINLY SERN WY AND WRN NEBRASKA THIS AFTERNOON.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: LONG-LIVED CELLS WITH A HISTORY OF HAIL CONTINUE SEWD NOW INTO ERN WY WITH OTHER CELLS FORMING ON A NEARBY OUTFLOW/FRONT OVER NWRN NEB. AHEAD OF THIS ACTIVITY...TEMPERATURES ARE RATHER COOL AND JUDGING FROM THE 12Z LBF SOUNDING...CAPPING/CIN MAY BECOME A PROBLEM FOR THE ONGOING CELLS. HOWEVER...HEATING WILL PERSIST...AND WITH TIME CIN WILL ERODE. IT IS UNCLEAR WHETHER OR NOT THE ONGOING ACTIVITY WILL SURVIVE AND/OR IF ADDITIONAL ACTIVITY WILL BECOME DOMINANT. IN EITHER CASE...A GRADUAL UPWARD TREND IN STORM COVERAGE IS ANTICIPATED UNDER THE INFLUENCE OF A SHORTWAVE TROUGH. HAIL IS LIKELY WITH THE STRONGER CELLS...AND PERHAPS A WIND THREAT LATER TODAY IF CELLS CAN MERGE INTO A LINE AS SUGGESTED BY SEVERAL CONVECTIVE ALLOWING MODELS. ADDITIONAL ISOLATED STORMS ARE LIKELY WEST OF THIS INITIAL ACTIVITY BY LATE AFTERNOON OVER THE HIGHER TERRAIN IN SERN WY AS WELL.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: ISOLATED SUPERCELLS ARE POSSIBLE THIS AFTERNOON WITH A THREAT OF LARGE HAIL...DAMAGING WIND...AND POSSIBLY A TORNADO OR TWO. THE THREAT WILL TRANSITION TO AN ENHANCED WIND THREAT THIS EVENING AS STORMS INCREASE IN COVERAGE.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: STORM INITIATION HAS RECENTLY OCCURRED ACROSS SERN VA NEAR A WARM-FRONTAL BOUNDARY. RICH MOISTURE AND STRONG HEATING HAS CONTRIBUTED TO THE DEVELOPMENT OF MODERATE INSTABILITY...WITH MLCAPE OF 1500-2000 J/KG IN PLACE ALONG AND SOUTH OF THE BOUNDARY PER RECENT MESOANALYSIS. EFFECTIVE SHEAR OF 30-40 KTS WILL SUPPORT THE POTENTIAL FOR SUPERCELL DEVELOPMENT WITH THE INITIAL ACTIVITY...WITH AN ATTENDANT THREAT FOR LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WIND. WHILE LOW-LEVEL FLOW IS NOT PARTICULARLY STRONG...VEERING LOW-LEVEL WIND PROFILES AND THE POTENTIAL FOR FAVORABLE BOUNDARY INTERACTION WILL ALSO RESULT IN A THREAT FOR A TORNADO OR TWO WITH ANY SUPERCELLS THAT CAN BE MAINTAINED. FURTHER WEST...CU HAS BEEN INCREASING ALONG A LEE TROUGH AS LARGE-SCALE ASCENT INCREASES AHEAD OF A CONVECTIVELY-ENHANCED VORT MAX CURRENTLY OVER ERN OH. ISOLATED SUPERCELLS WILL ALSO BE POSSIBLE THIS AFTERNOON IF DEEP CONVECTION CAN INITIATE IN THIS AREA...WITH A PRIMARY THREAT OF LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WIND. TSTM COVERAGE IS EXPECTED TO INCREASE THIS EVENING AS STRONGER ASCENT OVERSPREADS THE AREA...WITH POTENTIAL UPSCALE GROWTH AND A TRANSITION TO AN ENHANCED DAMAGING WIND THREAT. WW ISSUANCE IS POSSIBLE BEFORE 21Z IF CURRENT ACTIVITY CONTINUES TO INCREASE IN COVERAGE...WITH WW ISSUANCE BECOMING LIKELY BY THIS EVENING IN RESPONSE TO THE INCREASING WIND DAMAGE THREAT.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: ISOLATED SEVERE STORMS CONTINUE...MAINLY ACROSS THE EASTERN PARTS OF THE WW AREA. DEVELOPING STORMS AMIDST AN UNSTABLE AIRMASS ACROSS WESTERN PARTS OF THE DISCUSSION AREA WILL LIKELY NECESSITATE A WW ISSUANCE BY 21Z.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: ISOLATED STRONG TO OCCASIONALLY SEVERE STORMS ARE ONGOING ACROSS PRIMARILY EASTERN PARTS OF THE DISCUSSION AREA AT THE CURRENT TIME. THIS ACTIVITY APPEARS TO BE ELEVATED ATOP A STRONG CAPPING INVERSION BASED AT AROUND 700MB...WITH INSTABILITY DUE TO STEEP LAPSE RATES ALOFT CONTINUING TO SUPPORT A THREAT FOR LARGE HAIL IN THE STRONGEST ACTIVITY. A STORM IN SHERIDAN/BOX BUTTE COUNTIES IN NEBRASKA PRODUCED SIGNIFICANT HAIL IN THE PAST HOUR. THIS THREAT MAY CONTINUE SOUTHEASTWARD OVER THE NEXT HOUR...ALTHOUGH UNCERTAINTY EXISTS WITH REGARD TO HOW LONG THIS STORM WILL REMAIN SEVERE WITH SOUTHEASTWARD EXTENT. ADDITIONAL DEVELOPMENT SEEMS LIKELY WEST OF THIS ACTIVITY...AND WEST OF AN OUTFLOW/DIFFERENTIAL HEATING BOUNDARY CURRENTLY ACROSS EAST-CENTRAL WYOMING AND NORTHEASTERN NEBRASKA. WITH WEAK UPSLOPE FLOW BENEATH 40-KNOT WNWLY MID-LEVEL FLOW AND STRONGER SURFACE-BASED INSTABILITY...STORMS SHOULD BECOME MORE WIDESPREAD WITH SEVERE HAIL AND DAMAGING WIND POSSIBLE. GIVEN THE EMERGING THREAT...WW ISSUANCE WILL LIKELY BE NEEDED BEFORE 21Z.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SCATTERED THUNDERSTORM DEVELOPMENT IS LIKELY TO CONTINUE ACROSS THE DISCUSSION AREA OVER THE NEXT 1-2 HOURS. A WW MAY BE NEEDED FOR THIS AREA.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A FEW ISOLATED THUNDERSTORMS HAVE DEVELOPED IN SOUTHWESTERN INDIANA AND FAR EASTERN MISSOURI IN THE PAST HOUR. LATEST MESOANALYSIS INDICATES AN UNCAPPED AIRMASS OVER THE REGION...WITH MODERATE TO STRONG INSTABILITY SUPPORTIVE OF CONTINUED DEVELOPMENT OF THIS ACTIVITY THROUGH THE AFTERNOON. WIND PROFILES ARE PRIMARILY WESTERLY WITH MINIMAL VEERING...AND 35-45 KNOT DEEP SHEAR WILL SUPPORT STORM ORGANIZATION. LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WIND GUSTS ARE THE MOST LIKELY THREAT WITH THIS ACTIVITY AS STORMS MATURE...WITH UPSCALE GROWTH INTO ONE OR MORE COMPLEXES POSSIBLE THROUGH THE EVENING HOURS. A TORNADO CANNOT COMPLETELY BE RULED OUT GIVEN STORM DEVELOPMENT ALONG A SYNOPTIC-SCALE STATIONARY FRONT. TRENDS WILL CONTINUE TO BE MONITORED...AND A WW MAY BE NEEDED IN THE NEXT 1-3 HOURS DEPENDING ON CONVECTIVE DEVELOPMENT DURING THAT TIME FRAME.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: CONVECTION FORMING OVER CNTRL KS MAY DEVELOP EWD ALONG THE QUASI-STATIONARY FRONT INTO PARTS OF CNTRL MO THIS EVENING. ALTHOUGH DEEP SHEAR IS WEAK WITH WRN EXTENT RENDERING UNCERTAINTY IN THE DEGREE OF SUSTENANCE/ORGANIZATION...VERY LARGE BUOYANCY COULD SUPPORT A RISK FOR ISOLATED SEVERE HAIL/WIND.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: 21Z SURFACE ANALYSIS PLACED A 1010 MB CYCLONE OVER CNTRL KS ALONG A QUASI-STATIONARY FRONT THAT EXTENDS EWD THROUGH THE KTOP/KMKC AREA INTO E-CNTRL MO OVER AUDRAIN COUNTY. INITIAL TSTM DEVELOPMENT NEAR THE MS RIVER IS WITHIN A MUCH MORE FAVORABLY SHEARED ENVIRONMENT AND THIS ACTIVITY SHOULD LARGELY PROGRESS E OF THE MS RIVER WITHIN NEWLY-ISSUED WW 354. FARTHER W...AN ISOLATED CB HAS FORMED OVER WABAUNSEE COUNTY KS BENEATH A DRIFTING PLUME OF CIRROSTRATUS. ALTHOUGH THIS CIRRUS PLUME RENDERS UNCERTAINTY IN THE DEGREE OF CU DEVELOPMENT DOWNSTREAM...IT IS PLAUSIBLE THAT WEAK CONVERGENCE ALONG THE FRONT MIGHT SUSTAIN A FEW STORMS ALONG THE FRONT THROUGH THE EVENING GIVEN VERY LARGE INSTABILITY. UPDRAFTS SHOULD STRUGGLE TO ORGANIZE AMIDST WEAK SHEAR /EFFECTIVE VALUES AOB 25-KT/...BUT ISOLATED OCCURRENCES OF LARGE HAIL AND SEVERE WINDS ARE POSSIBLE.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: STRONG TO SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS MAY POSE A STRONG...LOCALLY DAMAGING WIND THREAT THROUGH THIS EVENING. THE AREA WILL CONTINUE TO BE MONITORED FOR POSSIBLE WATCH ISSUANCE.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: THE AIRMASS ACROSS EASTERN KY HAS BEEN RECOVERING IN THE WAKE OF EARLY MORNING CONVECTIVE DEBRIS/CLOUD COVER AND DEWPOINTS IN TO UPPER 60S TO LOW 70S HAVE NOSED INTO THE REGION SOUTH OF A WARM FRONT. STRONG INSTABILITY WITH EFFECTIVE SHEAR NEAR 35 KT WILL SUPPORT CELLULAR STRUCTURES WHICH MAY AT TIMES EXHIBIT SUPERCELL CHARACTERISTICS. HOWEVER...MODEST MIDLEVEL LAPSE RATES WILL BE A LIMITING FACTOR IN STORM INTENSITY. ON THE OTHER HAND...STEEP LOW LEVEL LAPSE RATES COMBINED WITH PW VALUES AOA 1.5 INCHES WILL SUPPORT SPORADIC STRONG WIND GUSTS. THE AREA WILL CONTINUE TO BE MONITORED FOR POSSIBLE WATCH ISSUANCE.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: VERY LARGE HAIL AND SEVERE WIND GUSTS WILL REMAIN POSSIBLE WITH A PAIR OF SUPERCELLS MOVING SE NEAR THE DEN METRO AREA AND W OF LBF. THIS AND/OR NEW ACTIVITY SHOULD EVENTUALLY DEVELOP S OF WW 352. AN ADDITIONAL WW ISSUANCE AND/OR LOCAL AREAL EXTENSIONS APPEAR LIKELY BY 00Z.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A PAIR OF ROBUST SUPERCELLS WERE LOCATED OVER SRN WELD COUNTY CO AND KEITH COUNTY NEB AS OF 2215Z. OVERALL ENVIRONMENT WILL REMAIN SUPPORTIVE OF VERY LARGE HAIL AND ISOLATED SEVERE WIND GUSTS WITH THESE STORMS AS THEY CONTINUE TO TRACK TOWARDS THE SRN EDGE OF WW 352. ALTHOUGH DEEP SHEAR DOES WEAKEN WITH SRN EXTENT...MODERATE TO LARGE BUOYANCY N/E OF A QUASI-STATIONARY FRONT OVER CNTRL KS TO THE FRONT RANGE SHOULD FAVOR SUSTENANCE OF AT LEAST AN ISOLATED SEVERE RISK FARTHER S OF WW 352. ADDITIONAL TSTM DEVELOPMENT APPEARS PLAUSIBLE DURING THE EVENING ALONG THE FLANKING CU/TRAILING OUTFLOW ASSOCIATED WITH THE KEITH COUNTY SUPERCELL.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: VERY LARGE HAIL AND ISOLATED SEVERE WIND ARE THE PRIMARY NEAR-TERM HAZARDS...BUT A TORNADO OR TWO IS ALSO POSSIBLE WITH SUPERCELLS PROGRESSING ALONG A REMNANT OUTFLOW BOUNDARY OVER THE NEB PANHANDLE. WITH TIME...UPSCALE GROWTH SHOULD FOSTER A PREDOMINANT WIND RISK TOWARDS THE NEB/CO/KS BORDER AREA.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A FEW SUPERCELLS HAVE FORMED OVER THE WRN NEB PANHANDLE IN THE WAKE OF A LEAD SUPERCELL THAT DISSIPATED W OF LBF. WITH A REMNANT OUTFLOW BOUNDARY EVIDENT FROM NEAR IML TO BFF...THIS RENEWED DEVELOPMENT IS OCCURRING WITHIN A LOCALIZED ENVIRONMENT FAVORABLE FOR A SHORT-TERM TORNADO RISK GIVEN LOWERED LCLS AND ENHANCED LOW-LEVEL SRH. WITH TIME...TSTM AMALGAMATION SHOULD RENDER MORE PROGRESSIVE COLD POOL DEVELOPMENT AND TEMPER THE VERY LARGE HAIL RISK WHILE LEADING TO A MORE WIDESPREAD SEVERE WIND RISK. DOWNSTREAM WW ISSUANCE INTO PARTS OF THE WFO GLD AREA SEEMS PROBABLE BY 01-02Z. ..GRAMS.. 06/25/2015 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: VIGOROUS THUNDERSTORM DEVELOPMENT ACROSS CENTRAL VA WILL POSE A DAMAGING WIND THREAT INTO THE EVENING HOURS AS THE STORMS TRACK SOUTHEASTWARD. A TORNADO OR TWO ALSO WILL BE POSSIBLE...ESPECIALLY NEAR THE TIDEWATER/CHESAPEAKE PORTIONS OF EASTERN VA.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A MODERATELY UNSTABLE ENVIRONMENT STILL EXISTS ACROSS MUCH OF WW 353 EARLY THIS EVENING. A BELT OF STRONG EFFECTIVE SHEAR IS IMPINGING ON THE AREA NOW AND A NEW BAND OF VIGOROUS CONVECTION IS QUICKLY DEVELOPING NEAR ACROSS CENTRAL VA. HI-RES GUIDANCE CONTINUES TO BE CONSISTENT IN SUGGESTING THESE CELLS WILL DEVELOP INTO ONE OF BOWING SEGMENTS AS THEY TRACK SOUTHEAST ACROSS CENTRAL INTO SOUTHEAST VA. LATEST VWP DATA FROM AKQ HAS SHOWN AN INCREASE IN THE LOW LEVEL HODOGRAPH OVER THE LAST 30 MINUTES OR SO. THIS IS LIKELY IN RESPONSE TO BACKING/STRENGTHENING LOW LEVEL FLOW IN THE VICINITY OF THE SURFACE WARM FRONT NEAR THE TIDEWATER/CHESAPEAKE AREA. ANY CELLS THAT CAN REMAIN DISCRETE WOULD IN TURN POSE A GREATER TORNADO THREAT WHEN INTERACTING WITH THIS BOUNDARY/BACKED LOW LEVEL FLOW. HOWEVER...THE MAIN THREAT IS EXPECTED TO BE STRONG...DAMAGING WINDS. ..LEITMAN.. 06/25/2015 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: ISOLATED SEVERE RISK IN THE FORM OF LARGE HAIL AND WIND MAY PERSIST THROUGH ABOUT SUNSET...BUT SHOULD WEAKEN THEREAFTER AND MITIGATE THE NEED FOR A WW ISSUANCE.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A FEW PROBABLE SEVERE STORMS HAVE FORMED ALONG THE QUASI-STATIONARY FRONT ARCING FROM CNTRL KS SWWD TO THE RATON MESA. WITHIN A HOT/DEEPLY-MIXED THERMODYNAMIC ENVIRONMENT...STEEP TROPOSPHERIC LAPSE RATES AS SAMPLED BY 00Z DDC RAOB WILL FAVORABLY SUPPORT A CONTINUED ISOLATED SEVERE HAIL/WIND RISK. BUT AMIDST MODEST DEEP SHEAR...UPDRAFTS HAVE THUS FAR APPEARED SOMEWHAT PULSE-LIKE AND REMAIN TIED TO THE FRONT/STORM-SCALE OUTFLOW. THE ONSET OF NOCTURNAL SURFACE COOLING/INCREASING MLCIN IN THE ABSENCE OF A ROBUST LLJ SHOULD RESULT IN CONVECTION DECAYING WITHIN AN HOUR OR SO OF SUNSET.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: MIXED SEVERE HAIL/WIND RISKS APPEARS TO BE TRANSITIONING TO PREDOMINANTLY WIND WITH SEVERAL MERGING CLUSTERS ACROSS THE LOWER MO TO MID-MS VALLEYS.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: LEAD TSTM CLUSTERS HAVE STRUGGLED TO MOVE E OF THE MS RIVER...WHILE UPSTREAM CONVECTION OVER CNTRL MO HAS ACCELERATED SEWD WITH A MEASURED WIND GUST TO 61 KT IN RANDOLPH COUNTY AT 0012Z. CONTINUED AMALGAMATION OF UPDRAFTS SHOULD LESSEN THE HAIL THREAT DESPITE AMPLE BUOYANCY PER MODIFIED 00Z TOP RAOB. THE COLD POOL ACCELERATION OF THE WRN CLUSTERS SHOULD FOSTER AN OVERALL MCS PROGRESSION ACROSS PARTS E-CNTRL MO INTO SRN IL THROUGH LATE EVENING. WITH THIS OCCURRING ALONG THE BACKGROUND QUASI-STATIONARY FRONT/ASSOCIATED MLCAPE GRADIENT...SCATTERED SWATHS OF DAMAGING WINDS APPEAR POSSIBLE. ..GRAMS.. 06/26/2015 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: ALTHOUGH SEVERE RISK HAS EFFECTIVELY WANED ACROSS WW 355...MONITORING FOR UPSTREAM ELEVATED TSTM DEVELOPMENT EVOLVING FROM NERN KS/FAR SERN NEB AND POSSIBLE ADDITIONAL WW ISSUANCE. THERE IS UNCERTAINTY OVER THE DEGREE OF SEVERITY WITH THIS NEXT ROUND...WHICH MAY ONLY HAVE AN ISOLATED/MARGINAL SEVERE HAIL/WIND RISK.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: INITIAL CLUSTER OF SEVERE STORMS WITHIN WW 355 HAS PROGRESSED TOWARDS THE MS RIVER WITHIN WW 354. RECENT ESRL/NCEP HRRR/S REMAIN INSISTENT ON REDEVELOPING CONVECTION NEAR/W OF THE MO RIVER WITHIN A ZONE OF MODEST ISENTROPIC ASCENT N OF THE CONVECTIVELY-MODIFIED QUASI-STATIONARY FRONT S OF THE I-70 CORRIDOR ACROSS PARTS OF CNTRL KS TO CNTRL MO. FINAL VISIBLE IMAGERY INDICATED INITIAL CB DEVELOPMENT INVOF CNK AND IT APPEARS PLAUSIBLE THAT THIS MAY BLOSSOM E/NE NEAR THE NEB/KS BORDER GIVEN THE LARGE POTENTIAL BUOYANCY SAMPLED IN 00Z TOP RAOB. ON THE PERIPHERY OF MODERATE EFFECTIVE SHEAR...STORMS WILL HAVE A RISK FOR SEVERE HAIL INITIALLY THAT MAY EVENTUALLY EVOLVE INTO A BROADER CLUSTER WITH A PREDOMINANT WIND RISK.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: DAMAGING WINDS AND HAIL WILL CONTINUE TO BE POSSIBLE FROM NEAR RICHMOND TO PETERSBURG VA...SOUTHEAST TOWARD WAKEFIELD.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: THE LEAD SUPERCELL IN A THUNDERSTORM COMPLEX NOW LOCATED OVER CHESTERFIELD COUNTY IS LIKELY TO CONTINUE PRODUCING DAMAGING WINDS AND MARGINALLY SEVERE HAIL AS IT TRACKS SOUTH/SOUTHEAST. WEAK PRESSURE FALLS ACROSS THE REGION HAVE RESULTED IN BACKING LOW LEVEL FLOW AND AN INCREASING LOW LEVEL HODOGRAPH FROM AKQ VWP WHICH SHOWS NEARLY 200 M2/S2 SRH. THIS COULD AID IN TORNADO DEVELOPMENT IN THE LEAD SUPERCELL...IN ADDITION TO THE DAMAGING WIND THREAT OVER THE NEXT HOUR OR TWO. AS THE STORMS APPROACH AKQ/FAR SOUTHEASTERN VA SOME WEAKENING WILL BE POSSIBLE AS BOUNDARY LAYER STABILIZATION WILL BE GREATER DUE IN PART TO EARLIER CONVECTION ACROSS THAT AREA. ..LEITMAN.. 06/26/2015 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SMALL MCS CLUSTER AND EMBEDDED BOWING STRUCTURE CROSSING THE CO/NEB BORDER AREA MAY EVOLVE SEWD ACROSS PARTS OF SWRN NEB AND NERN KS WITH A RISK FOR SEVERE WIND GUSTS. DOWNSTREAM WW ISSUANCE IS POSSIBLE BY 03Z.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: AREAL EXTENT OF 50+ DBZ REFLECTIVITY HAS LARGELY CONSOLIDATED TO ALONG THE NEB/CO BORDER AREA WITH AN EMBEDDED STORM-SCALE BOW THAT HAS ACCELERATED SEWD INTO PERKINS/CHASE COUNTY NEB. DESPITE THE LACK OF APPRECIABLE BUOYANCY IN THE CONVECTIVELY-MODIFIED 00Z LBF RAOB...A NARROW RIBBON OF MIDDLE 60S SURFACE DEW POINTS IS EVIDENT ACROSS NWRN KS. THIS MOISTURE PLUME MAY BE SUFFICIENT TO MAINTAIN STRONG TO SEVERE WIND GUSTS AS THE MCS PROGRESSES SEWD AMIDST 40-50 KT EFFECTIVE SHEAR GIVEN LOW-LEVEL ELYS BENEATH MODERATE MID-LEVEL WLYS AS SAMPLED BY GLD VWP DATA. ..GRAMS.. 06/26/2015 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: OVERALL SEVERE RISK HAS DIMINISHED...BUT ISOLATED DAMAGING WINDS AND MARGINALLY SEVERE HAIL SHOULD REMAIN POSSIBLE THROUGH SCHEDULED EXPIRATION TIMES FOR WW/S 354/356. ADDITIONAL WW ISSUANCES ARE NOT ANTICIPATED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: SEVERAL TSTM CLUSTERS REMAIN ALONG A CONVECTIVELY-MODIFIED QUASI-STATIONARY FRONTAL ZONE. MUCH OF THIS ACTIVITY HAS WEAKENED AFTER SUNSET...ESPECIALLY WITHIN WW 356. CONTINUED NOCTURNAL COOLING AND INCREASING MLCIN SUGGESTS OVERALL SEVERE RISK SHOULD REMAIN LIMITED AND SPORADIC FOR THE DURATION OF BOTH WW/S. THE BEST CHANCE AT A LOCALIZED DAMAGING WIND RISK WILL PROBABLY REMAIN WITHIN WW 354 WITH AN MCV CURRENTLY CROSSING THE STL METRO AREA...GIVEN A RECENT STRONG WIND GUST TO 44 KT AT KCPS AT 0253Z. BUT WITH CONVECTION REMAINING S OF A CONFINED BELT OF STRONG MID-LEVEL WLYS OVER NRN/CNTRL IL/IND...THIS MCV SHOULD STRUGGLE TO INTENSIFY INTO A SUSTAINABLE SEVERE RISK. ..GRAMS.. 06/26/2015 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: ONGOING BOWING SEGMENTS WILL CONTINUE TO TRACK EAST/SOUTHEAST ACROSS SOUTHEAST VA INTO PERHAPS FAR NORTHEAST NC OVER THE NEXT 1-2 HOURS. A LOCAL WATCH EXTENSION IN TIME MAY BE NEEDED FOR PARTS OF WFO AKQ THROUGH 5Z OR 6Z.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A LOCAL EXTENSION IN TIME MAY BE NEEDED FOR WATCH 353 ACROSS PORTIONS OF WFO AKQ. CURRENT TIMING TAKES THE BOWING SEGMENT BEYOND THE COASTAL AREAS BETWEEN 0430Z AND 0500Z. THE TRAILING AREA OF STORMS WILL LIKELY REMAIN OVER SE VA AND PERHAPS FAR NE NC A BIT LONGER. THE ENVIRONMENT FURTHER SOUTH INTO FAR NE NC WILL REMAIN SOMEWHAT FAVORABLE FOR SPORADIC STRONG TO LOCALLY SEVERE WIND GUSTS. AS SUCH...THE SEVERE THUNDERSTORM WATCH MAY NEED TO BE EXTENDED FOR AN HOUR OR TWO. ..LEITMAN.. 06/26/2015 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: WITH WW 352 SCHEDULED TO EXPIRE AT 04Z...LOCAL TEMPORAL EXTENSION IS POSSIBLE FOR PARTS OF THE WFO BOU CWA.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: FINAL ROUND OF STRONG TO LOCALLY SEVERE CONVECTION THAT RECENTLY CROSSED INTO N-CNTRL/NERN CO MAY POSE A LINGERING RISK BEYOND THE 04Z SCHEDULED WW EXPIRATION ALONG PARTS OF THE FRONT RANGE WHERE SURFACE TEMPERATURES REMAIN AROUND 70 DEG F. AMIDST VERTICALLY VEERING WIND PROFILES WITH HEIGHT PER FTG VWP DATA...THERE REMAINS CONCERN FOR A SWD-MOVING ORGANIZED CLUSTER AFFECTING PARTS OF THE DEN METRO AREA. BUT OVERALL NOCTURNAL BOUNDARY-LAYER STABILIZATION AND EARLIER CONVECTIVE OVERTURNING SUGGESTS THE RISK MAY REMAIN LIMITED TO MARGINALLY SEVERE HAIL AND STRONG WIND GUSTS. ..GRAMS.. 06/26/2015 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: STRONG TO LOCALLY SEVERE WIND GUSTS MAY DEVELOP WITH A STRENGTHENING COLD POOL ALONG THE MO/NEB BORDER INTO NERN KS. PORTIONS OF WW 355 MAY BE TEMPORALLY EXTENDED OR REPLACED BY A NEW WW PRIOR TO 06Z SCHEDULED EXPIRATION.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: TSTMS N OF THE CONVECTIVELY-MODIFIED QUASI-STATIONARY FRONT HAVE JUST BEGUN TO ACCELERATE E/SE ACROSS PARTS OF NERN KS AND MO/NEB BORDER AREA. THE BULK OF THIS ACTIVITY SHOULD LARGELY REMAIN W OF WW 355 THROUGH 06Z WW EXPIRATION...BUT EVENING CAM/S ARE GENERALLY SUGGESTIVE OF A PERIOD OF UPSCALE GROWTH YIELDING STRONG TO PERHAPS LOCALLY SEVERE WIND GUSTS. ALTHOUGH THIS REGION LIES ON THE FRINGE OF MODERATE MID-LEVEL WLYS PER AREA VWP DATA...THE LARGEST POTENTIAL BUOYANCY IN THE REGION WAS SAMPLED IN THE 00Z TOP RAOB. GIVEN THE COMMENCEMENT OF FORWARD-PROPAGATION...CONCERN IS INCREASING FOR STRONG DOWNDRAFTS TO PRODUCE AT LEAST ISOLATED WIND DAMAGE. ..GRAMS.. 06/26/2015 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: STRONG TO LOCALLY SEVERE WINDS AND MARGINALLY SEVERE HAIL MAY PERSIST FOR A FEW MORE HOURS WITHIN/NEAR WW 357...MAINLY ALONG THE WRN KS/ERN CO BORDER. ADDITIONAL WW ISSUANCES ARE NOT ANTICIPATED ATTM.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: REMNANT COLD POOL FROM THE CNTRL HIGH PLAINS MCS THAT IS CROSSING NWRN KS/E-CNTRL CO PRODUCED A MEASURED WIND GUST TO 50 KT AT KGLD AT 0425Z. THIS ACTIVITY SHOULD CONTINUE S/SEWD...WITH AN ARRAY OF STORM-SCALE OUTFLOW MAINTAINING DEVELOPMENT SWD ACROSS PORTIONS OF W-CNTRL KS THAT HAVE YET TO OVERTURN TONIGHT. OVERALL CONVECTIVE INTENSITY IS LIKELY AT/NEAR PEAK AS ACTIVITY SHIFTS S OF THE PLUME OF RICHER SURFACE DEW POINTS EVIDENT EARLIER ACROSS NWRN KS AND CONVECTION LIKELY OUTPACES STRONGER MID/HIGH-LEVEL WINDS. GIVEN THE RECENT WEAKENING TREND TO CONVECTION S OF WW 357...A DOWNSTREAM WW ISSUANCE APPEARS UNLIKELY INTO SWRN KS. ..GRAMS.. 06/26/2015 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE THREAT FOR DAMAGING WINDS WILL CONTINUE FOR A FEW HOURS SOUTH OF LOCALLY-EXTENDED SEVERE THUNDERSTORM WATCH 357. A NEW WATCH IS POSSIBLE PRIOR TO 08Z.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: TSTMS HAVE ORGANIZED INTO TWO PRONOUNCED BOWING SEGMENTS AS OF 0645Z...ONE MOVING THROUGH THE KANSAS CITY METRO AREA AND ANOTHER WEST/SOUTHWEST OF LAWRENCE KS. IN THE SHORT TERM...THESE BOWING SEGMENTS MAY MERGE AND CONTINUE MOVING SOUTHEAST ALONG A REMNANT OUTFLOW BOUNDARY EXTENDING FROM EAST-CENTRAL KS INTO SWRN MO. WITH A MODEST WSWLY LOW-LEVEL JET REMAINING IN PLACE AND MODERATE BUOYANCY ALONG/SOUTH OF THE OUTFLOW BOUNDARY...AN ORGANIZED MCS MAY CONTINUE MOVING SOUTHEAST THROUGH THE PRE-DAWN HOURS WITH A CONTINUED RISK FOR DAMAGING WINDS. GIVEN THESE ANTICIPATED TRENDS...A NEW WW SOUTH OF LOCALLY-EXTENDED WW 357 IS POSSIBLE BY 08Z.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE SEVERE WEATHER THREAT HAS RAPIDLY DIMINISHED WITHIN SEVERE THUNDERSTORM WATCH 357...AND THUNDERSTORMS OVER SOUTHWEST KANSAS WILL LIKELY NOT REQUIRE A WATCH.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: CONVECTIVELY GENERATED OUTFLOW COMBINED WITH NOCTURNAL COOLING HAS SUBSTANTIALLY REDUCED INSTABILITY ACROSS WW 357...AND THE SEVERE WEATHER THREAT ACROSS THE WATCH AREA HAS RAPIDLY DIMINISHED. THUNDERSTORMS OVER SWRN KANSAS ALONG THE AGGREGATE OUTFLOW BOUNDARY WERE NON SEVERE AS OF 0720Z. ALTHOUGH SOME POTENTIAL REMAINS FOR AN ISOLATED NEAR-SEVERE GUST OVER THE NEXT COUPLE HOURS...THE OVERALL RISK WILL REMAIN LOW AND A DOWNSTREAM WATCH IS NOT ANTICIPATED. ..BUNTING.. 06/26/2015 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE THREAT FOR DAMAGING WINDS CONTINUES ACROSS THE REMAINING VALID PORTIONS OF THE WATCH AREA...AND A LOCAL AREAL EXTENSION MAY BE NEEDED SOUTH OF EXISTING WATCH AREA.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: REGIONAL COMPOSITE RADAR IMAGERY REVEALS A WELL-DEVELOPED BOWING MCS WITH A HISTORY OF SEVERE GUSTS/DAMAGE ACROSS SOUTHWESTERN MO AT 0910Z MOVING SOUTHEAST AT 40 KTS. ALTHOUGH THE GUST FRONT HAS SURGED WELL AHEAD OF THE SOUTHERN-MOST PORTION OF THE BOWING SEGMENT...THE PRESENCE OF A WELL-DEVELOPED COLD POOL...AND A BOOKEND VORTEX NEAR SEDALIA SUGGESTS A CONTINUED SEVERE WIND THREAT FOR AT LEAST A COUPLE MORE HOURS. AT THE CURRENT RATE OF MOVEMENT THE BOWING SEGMENT WILL APPROACH THE SOUTHERN EXTENT OF THE WATCH AREA BETWEEN 10Z AND 1030Z. GIVEN MODERATE MUCAPE /1500-2000 J/KG/ ALONG/SOUTH OF A REMNANT OUTFLOW BOUNDARY IN THE IMMEDIATE DOWNSTREAM ENVIRONMENT...A CONTINUED RISK FOR DAMAGING WINDS WILL EXIST AND A LOCAL AREAL EXTENSION OF WW 358 MAY BE NEEDED. ..BUNTING.. 06/26/2015 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A FEW STRONG TO SVR WIND GUSTS AND HAIL EVENTS WILL CONTINUE TO ACCOMPANY ISOLATED TSTMS DEVELOPING FROM THE TX S PLAINS INTO S-CNTRL KS. A WW IS NOT ANTICIPATED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: ISOLATED TSTMS ARE DEVELOPING NEAR A SWD-MOVING COLD FRONT...WHICH EXTENDS FROM APPROXIMATELY 20 N AMA TO NEAR ICT AS OF 10Z. THIS ACTIVITY APPEARS TO BE CO-LOCATED WITH A VEERED 30 KT LLJ ORIENTED FROM THE PERMIAN BASIN OF TX INTO THE OZARKS. DESPITE GENERALLY WEAK FLOW ALOFT...SUFFICIENT VEERING OF WINDS THROUGH THE MIDLEVELS IS OCCURRING TO YIELD EFFECTIVE SHEAR VALUES OF 25-35 KT. LATEST RADAR TRENDS SUGGEST CONVECTION IS ASSUMING PULSE TO WEAKLY ORGANIZED MULTICELL CHARACTERISTICS...WITH BRIEF UPWARD PULSES IN INTENSITY SUPPORTING INTERMITTENT AND LOCALIZED HAIL AND STRONG WIND GUSTS. THE LATTER THREAT MAY BE AT LEAST PARTIALLY ENHANCED BY A DRY LAYER NOTED IN THE LOWEST 2 KM AGL IN MODEL FORECAST SOUNDINGS...AS RECENT REPORTS HAVE SHOWN ISOLATED GUSTS OVER 60 MPH ACROSS WEST TX AND THE OK PANHANDLE. TRENDS SUGGEST TSTMS WILL CONTINUE SLOWLY DEVELOPING SWD INTO PORTIONS OF SWRN/CNTRL OK THROUGH MID-LATE MORNING...WITH LOCALIZED SVR THREAT REMAINING POSSIBLE...BUT WILL LIKELY REMAIN INSUFFICIENT TO WARRANT WW ISSUANCE.
